description: Return the markdown content of a dark-agent self-bootstrap resource by surface+target. Surfaces: system_prompt | compatibility_matrix | install_guide (requires target) | companion (requires target) | all. The resource URIs are also exposed via resources/read for harnesses that prefer the standard MCP path.

force_embedded.description: If true, bypass DARK_AGENT_BOOTSTRAP_DIR and use the embedded copy. Diagnostic; mostly for drift tests.

target.description: For install_guide: claude-desktop | claude-code | opencode | cline | cursor | continue. For companion: dark-research | [FUTURE-MCP-N]. Required for those surfaces; ignored otherwise.

name: dark_memory_agent_bootstrap
